description: Na₃Mg₄ScSi₈(O₁₁F)₂ is Esseneite-derived structured and crystallizes in the triclinic P1 space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.38-2.63 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.40-2.97 Å. There are four inequivalent Mg sites. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.05-2.11 Å. There is one shorter (2.04 Å) and one longer (2.05 Å) Mg-F bond length. In the second Mg site, Mg is bonded to four O and two F atoms to form MgO₄F₂ octahedra that share corners with four SiO₄ tetrahedra, edges with two equivalent ScO₆ octahedra, and edges with three MgO₄F₂ octahedra. There are two shorter (2.08 Å) and two longer (2.10 Å) Mg-O bond lengths. There is one shorter (2.05 Å) and one longer (2.07 Å) Mg-F bond length. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.03-2.10 Å. There is one shorter (2.10 Å) and one longer (2.12 Å) Mg-F bond length. In the fourth Mg site, Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with six SiO₄ tetrahedra and edges with three MgO₄F₂ octahedra. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.01-2.29 Å. Sc is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted ScO₆ octahedra that share corners with six SiO₄ tetrahedra and edges with three MgO₄F₂ octahedra. There are a spread of Sc-O bond distances ranging from 2.00-2.29 Å. There are eight inequivalent Si sites.
